_meta.title: StarCraft + Brood War single-player cheat codes
_meta.usage: In a single-player game press Enter, type the code, press Enter again. Codes are case-insensitive. Multiplayer has NO cheats.
_meta.note: Reference library (wiki-style). Codes + effects are the well-documented public set; sources below.

cheats.effect: God mode — your units/buildings are invincible
Unlimited energy — spells cost no mana
Free upgrades — units/tech upgrade with no cost
Lets you build every building (ignores tech-tree requirements)
Build units past the supply/psi/control limit
Reveals the entire map (removes unexplored fog)

cheats.code: war aint what it used to be
cheats.effect: Disables fog of war (permanent sight of explored areas)
Ends the current game as a loss
Disables victory/defeat conditions — mission never ends (keep playing)
Enables mission select; then type the mission name to jump to it (e.g. 'terran5', 'zerg3', 'protoss7'). Enter 'ophelia' first, then the code.
Plays a hidden Zerg theme song — only works while playing as Zerg
